activity.notes: William Jennings Bryan served as U.S. Secretary of State from 5 March 1913 until his resignation on 9 June 1915. He was also a three-time Democratic presidential nominee and a central Populist-era political figure. The user-supplied 'North American Republics' framing is not used because it is not a historical polity; ATLAS maps Bryan to his documented United States office.

sources.title: William Jennings Bryan — Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State records Bryan's appointment, entry on duty on 5 March 1913, and resignation on 9 June 1915.
